implementation: Render /booking with the existing public HTML and validated snapshot flow; eagerly import its CTA and FAQ within the route module.
Resolve public Booking backgrounds once during prerender, seed normalized sources into the browser, and render only the first background as eager/high priority.
Keep responsive URLs, quality and rotation; Gallery retains its runtime/lazy behavior. First image paints without its entrance animation; subsequent transitions including wraparound preserve fading.
Use native picture/source/img discovery instead of an additional preload, avoiding duplicate format downloads.

Validate the build response and snapshot; strict CMS builds reject unavailable/malformed backgrounds, while optional builds preserve an empty background and browser recovery. Empty published collections remain valid.
Keep no-JavaScript Booking copy and FAQ visible, with telephone/WhatsApp links replacing non-working buttons.

controlled.method: Three alternating before/after fresh Chromium runs, 390x900, reduced motion, identical photo bytes; entry JS and Booking API each artificially delayed 1500ms; not production LCP or field data
